description: Status of a conversion: "waiting", "done" (with download_url and expires_at; for "to": "pdfa" also "validation" – the PDF/A-2b conformance check by an independent validator: compliant, failed_rules, issues) or "error" (with an error code, e.g. timeout, killed, tool_error, empty_output, unsupported, source_unavailable, no_audio, signed_pdf / encrypted_pdf (to pdfa: a signed or password-protected PDF – tell the user why), expired, not_found). Pass "id" from convert, or "upload_id" from create_upload – before the file is uploaded the status is "waiting_for_upload" (with wait_seconds it waits for the upload too). Does not count toward limits.

return.description: "link" (default): status and download_url only. "content": when the job is done, also return the result inline – text formats (txt, md, csv, json, xml, srt…) up to 100 kB (longer text is cut), HTML as the inner <body> only, images (png, jpg, gif, webp) up to 1 MB; other formats always come back as a link. Use "content" when you need to read or show the result yourself.

upload_id.description: upload_id returned by create_upload (instead of id).

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the conversion to finish (0–25). If it is still running afterwards, the status is "waiting" – call get_job with the id.

name: get_job
title: Get conversion status
